Can OWL Handle Many-to-Many?

Released Aug 15, 2025, 11 min

Play Can OWL Handle Many-to-Many? on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

In my research for the LPG video, I repeatedly ran into the claim that LPGs can handle many-to-many relationships, while OWL/RDF graphs cannot. This had me scratching my head, and so in this video I will evaluate the claim. Spoiler: it's a myth. OWL/RDF is just as good at many-to-many relationships as LPGs are; they are both graphs.
